description: Source code implementing variable packing logic for GLSL shader variables, including expansion of struct variables and packing within specified limits.

classes.name: VariablePacker
classes.description: Class responsible for packing shader variables within specified vector limits.

methods.name: checkExpandedVariablesWithinPackingLimits
methods.description: Checks if expanded variables fit within the maximum vector limit.

methods.name: ExpandVariable
methods.description: Expands struct variables into individual fields.

methods.name: ExpandStructVariable
methods.description: Expands a struct variable into its fields.

methods.name: ExpandStructArrayVariable
methods.description: Expands array of struct variables into individual elements.

methods.name: GetVariablePackingRows
methods.description: Calculates the number of packing rows needed for a variable.

methods.name: makeColumnFlags
methods.description: Creates column flags for packing layout.

methods.name: fillColumns
methods.description: Fills specified columns in the packing layout.

methods.name: searchColumn
methods.description: Searches for available space in a column for packing.
